abilityDetails.text: Nightmare and its rider immune to fire. A pale, angular woman in translucent plate mail fashioned from giant scorpion chitin. Obe-Ixx, daughter of Azarumme, rose up from the prehistoric barbarian tribes of Tal-Yool to conquer all in her path. One day, she stood at the steps of an obsidian ziggurat deep within the trackless jungle. Forty nights later, Obe-Ixx emerged as the ur-vampire, bloodlust made flesh. Her dynasty would rise and fall again and again over the coming millennia.
